verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents continuous queries, which are SQL statements that run continuously to analyze incoming data in real time. Dataform adds scheduled, version-controlled transformation workflows with dependency graphs inside BigQuery, and pipelines can be managed in Git folders. Together these cover the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of incremental (delta-only) transformation models, detail on continuous-query outputs, limits and operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
